You can set the context path by setting the contextPath property. The context path is a list of colon-separated Java package names that contain schema derived classes. items.source: Spring’s O-X mapping operates through two global interfaces: Marshaller and Unmarshaller. These abstractions let you switch O-X mapping frameworks with relative ease, with little or no change required on the classes that do the marshalling. This approach has the additional benefit of making it possible to do XML marshalling with a mix-and-match approach (for example, some marshalling performed using JAXB and some by XStream) in a non-intrusive fashion, letting you use the strength of each technology.
items.translation: Spring 的 O-X 映射通过两个全局接口实现：Marshaller 和 Unmarshaller。这些抽象使得您可以轻松切换 O-X 映射框架，而无需对执行反序列化的类进行大量修改。这种方法还带来了额外的好处，即能够以非侵入式的方式采用混合匹配的方法进行 XML 序列化（例如，部分使用 JAXB 执行序列化，部分使用 XStream），从而利用每种技术的优势。

items.source: Spring provides a conversion from exceptions from the underlying O-X mapping tool to its own exception hierarchy with the XmlMappingException as the root exception. These runtime exceptions wrap the original exception so that no information is lost.

items.source:
This chapter, describes Spring’s Object-XML Mapping support. Object-XML
Mapping (O-X mapping for short) is the act of converting an XML document to and from
an object. This conversion process is also known as XML Marshalling, or XML
Serialization. This chapter uses these terms interchangeably.
items.translation: 本章介绍 Spring 的对象 -XML 映射支持。对象 -XML 映射（简称 O-X 映射）是将 XML 文档转换为对象，或将对象转换回 XML 文档的过程。该转换过程也称为 XML 反序列化或 XML 序列化。本章中这些术语可互换使用。

items.source:
Within the field of O-X mapping, a marshaller is responsible for serializing an
object (graph) to XML. In similar fashion, an unmarshaller deserializes the XML to
an object graph. This XML can take the form of a DOM document, an input or output
stream, or a SAX handler.
items.translation: 在 O-X 映射领域，Marshaller 负责将对象（图）序列化为 XML。类似地，Unmarshaller 将 XML 反序列化为对象图。该 XML 可以表现为 DOM 文档、输入或输出流，或者 SAX 处理器。

items.source: Some of the benefits of using Spring for your O/X mapping needs are:
items.translation: 使用 Spring 满足您的对象/XML (O/X) 映射需求的一些优势包括：

items.source:
Spring’s bean factory makes it easy to configure marshallers, without needing to
construct JAXB context, JiBX binding factories, and so on. You can configure the marshallers
as you would any other bean in your application context. Additionally, XML namespace-based
configuration is available for a number of marshallers, making the configuration even
simpler.
items.translation: Spring 的 BeanFactory 使得配置 Marshaller 变得非常简单，无需构建 JAXB Context、JiBX Binding Factory 等组件。您可以像在应用程序上下文中配置任何其他 Bean 一样来配置这些 Marshaller。此外，许多 Marshaller 都支持基于 XML 命名空间的配置，从而使配置更加简便。

items.translation: O-X 映射异常层次结构如下所示：

items.source:
The JiBX framework offers a solution similar to that which Hibernate provides for ORM: A
binding definition defines the rules for how your Java objects are converted to or from
XML. After preparing the binding and compiling the classes, a JiBX binding compiler
enhances the class files and adds code to handle converting instances of the classes
from or to XML.
items.translation: JiBX 框架提供了一种类似于 Hibernate 为 ORM 提供的解决方案：绑定定义（binding definition）定义了您的 Java 对象如何转换为或从 XML 转换的规则。在准备绑定并编译类之后，JiBX 绑定编译器会增强类文件，并添加用于将类的实例从 XML 转换或转换到 XML 的代码。

items.source: Although the marshal() method accepts a plain object as its first parameter, most Marshaller implementations cannot handle arbitrary objects. Instead, an object class must be mapped in a mapping file, be marked with an annotation, be registered with the marshaller, or have a common base class. Refer to the later sections in this chapter to determine how your O-X technology manages this.
